items: Article 169 is frequently asked in questions related to the creation or abolition of Legislative Councils.
Questions often contrast Article 170 (Composition of Assembly) with Article 171 (Composition of Council).
Article 196 is a crucial topic for state-level competitive exams regarding Money Bills.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 168 deals with the constitution of State Legislatures.
Article 169 specifies the creation or abolition of Legislative Councils in states.
Article 170 and Article 171 mandate the structural composition of the Legislative Assembly and Council.
Article 172 and Article 173 outline the duration of the Houses and the qualifications for state legislators.
Article 174 governs the sessions, prorogation, and dissolution of state legislative houses.
